name: PhoneInput
title: PhoneInput
summary: One 48px field that joins a country-code button and a number input, with a searchable country list that opens 6px below.
whenToUse: Any phone number field: partner applications, church contact details, prayer line call-backs.
Use it wherever numbers may come from outside the US; ISM partners and listeners call from many countries.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for SMS one-time codes (use a plain `.input` with `inputmode="numeric"`) or for typing a country alone (use Combobox).

props.name: optionalText
props.description: Tag such as "(optional)" shown after the label.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message under the field. Sets `aria-invalid` and the error shell.

props.name: suggested
props.description: Codes (from `countries`) pinned in a "Suggested" group above the full list.

props.name: searchable
props.default: true when there are more than 10 countries

props.name: defaultCountry
props.description: Initial country code (uncontrolled). Never blank: falls back to the first country.

props.name: value
props.description: Phone number in E.164, for example "+251911234567" (controlled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the E.164 value (spaces, dashes and brackets stripped) and details.

props.name: required
props.description: Mark required (`required` on the number input).

variantNotes: Default: country set from the site language or location, number empty with a placeholder.
Focus: `:focus-within` (or `.fm-focus` in static specs) gives the whole group the `--horizon-blue` border and `--shadow-focus`.
Error: `.fm-err` on the group (`--error` border on `--error-field-bg`), `aria-invalid="true"` on the number and one `.err` line.
List open: `aria-expanded="true"` tints the country button `--blue-tint` and turns the caret 180°.
Option hover / keyboard-active: `--blue-tint`. Selected: `--horizon-blue-dim` semibold with a blue tick in `.fm-tick`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The caret ⌄ means the list opens here; it rotates when open.
Never leave the country blank; default it and let people change it.
Show the flag as a two-letter code tile (`.fm-flag`), not an emoji or image, so it renders on every device.
Put the search field first when the list is longer than about 10 countries; pin a short "Suggested" group above "All countries".
Accept spaces, dashes and brackets while typing; store E.164 (+251911234567).
Keep the whole group 48px tall and the options 44px.
On phones, open the list as a full-height sheet with the search field focused.

accessibility: The country button's name includes country and code: "Country code: Ethiopia +251". Flag tiles are `aria-hidden`.
Keys on the list: type to search, Up / Down to move, Enter picks and returns focus to the number, Esc closes.
Use `type="tel"` and `autocomplete="tel-national"` on the number (the country button sets the code).
